messages:
Rina Kapoor: quick synthesis from this week's onboarding + renewal check-ins. three recurring asks across accounts: 1) per-feature billing exports for finance mapping, 2) improved sampler/truncation for long system prompts, 3) predictable nightly batch latency. dropping raw snippets and proposed next steps.
Diego Morales: thanks Rina. which customers, and any renewal risk flags?
Rina Kapoor: short map: 
- HelixHealth (onboarding): asking per-feature spend export; CFO asked for line items to tie to patient-search feature — flagged medium renewal risk if not solved before trial end.
- Satori Logistics (production): reports chat sessions balloon token costs when ops embed long manifests; they asked for server-side summarization or token cap policies.
- Verdant Analytics (onboarding -> barometer): nightly ETL job hitting p95 spikes at seq>1500, causing delayed reports.
Elliot Park: sounds like mix: product request (Helix), docs/quick feature/workflow (Satori), infra perf for Verdant. agree to triage separately.
Priya Shah: propose priority: Helix billing export (P0 due to finance + trial end), Verdant latency (P1 investigatory spike), Satori guidance and heuristics (P2, but provide interim doc).
Diego Morales: can we bundle Helix ask into a small billing-export MVP: CSV per-route with route_id, tokens_consumed, date, customer_tag? If so, product could ship quick.
Rina Kapoor: Helix asked for daily CSV + column with "feature_label" to map to product teams. sample row requested.
Diego Morales: sample CSV schema (to attach to ticket): "date,route_id,feature_label,request_count,total_tokens,usd_estimate"
Elliot Park: for Verdant, can eng-runtime run a nightly profile? collect p50/p95 for seq bins: 512/1024/1536/2048 and capture kernel selection + GPU utilization. If p95 delta > 1.8x between 1024->1536 escalate to infra.
Priya Shah: Satori workaround: recommend server-side summarizer pipe + client-side cap 4096 tokens, with examples. I'll draft the doc and attach.
Rina Kapoor: next steps: Diego to mock CSV export and confirm data retention policy; Elliot to schedule runtime profile; Priya to author the interim guidance doc; I'll own customer comms and renewal flags. ETA: EOD Thu for owners to post updates.
CS Bot: triage card created -> ID CS-4721 by Rina Kapoor. owners: @product-billing, @eng-runtime, @docs. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4721
Diego Morales: attached prototype curl -> billing-export (example): ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/export?start=2026-04-01&end=2026-04-07&format=csv&group_by=route" 
  -o helix-export.csv
```
Elliot Park: for runtime profiling I'll run: ```python
from infra.tools import profile_model
profile_model(model='redwood-2', seq_bins=[512,1024,1536,2048], batch=16, collect_gpu_metrics=True)
```
Priya Shah: drafted interim doc gist: key heuristics, sample prompt wrappers, and cost-saving tips. uploading to CS-4721 now.
Rina Kapoor: noted. Diego/Aaron from product-billing please confirm that daily CSV + 90d retention is doable. tagging product-billing.
Diego Morales: pinged @product-billing in ticket. quick note: CSV MVP scoped to last 90d, per-route labeling via API param.
Priya Shah: customer comms draft: "we're shipping a billing export MVP this month, a runtime perf investigation is in progress, and here's a temporary summarization guide." sharing to Helix & Verdant threads once owners confirm.
Elliot Park: I'll post p95 numbers here by tomorrow AM. if we see >1.8x, I'll request eng-runtime on-call priority.
Rina Kapoor: thanks team. if anyone spots similar asks in other accounts, paste into this thread so we can aggregate signals for the product roadmap. :mag_right:
thread_summary: CS captured three consistent asks (billing export, runtime perf, token-cost guidance). Card CS-4721 opened, owners assigned, and concrete next steps + artifacts (CSV schema, profiling commands, interim doc) were added.
